description: This file contains the definition of a data structure and a parsing utility for configuring voice mode settings in an application. It defines a state struct and a static parser that extracts configuration values from a dictionary, providing defaults and handling optional values.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: A data structure representing the current configuration state for voice mode gateway settings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: A static method that takes a configuration dictionary and default values to produce a configured state object, handling various optional and nested values within the dictionary.
